Awesome game. Very addictive. Feels like IJI and Binding of Isaac had an unholy child. I especially love the coop option. Also, good soundtrack.

I had many crashes at first. You can solve the problem by updating you XNA framework here: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=20914

I definitely enjoyed Risk of Rain, as it was super easy to play with friends and was a time consumer (Up to 200 minutes sometimes). I used Hamachi to create the IP for us to connect to, which usually worked out well, Single-Player wise it was fantastic. I felt satisfied with my ability especially trying to speed run it. The classes are varied and offer quite a few different styles of play, which is great! I don't usually like the one class one build sort of play, so the plethora of items and possible builds you can create are great. On the spec side of the game, it's very low CPU intenstive unless you have a lot of enemies in your game at once. For some reason the game doesn't really understand how to dump the sprites or data after you kill it. So after a while if you sit on the same level, it will inevitibly lag because of this... One issue I found was that the icon in my windows bar sometimes disappears, so I have to Alt-Tab to find it again, a minor inconvenience though worth noting. Some small things to add,

- Great soundtrack and atmosphere
- Somewhat existent lore and story.
- Plenty of Classes/Characters to play
- Lots of unlockable items
- A bunch of unlockable game modes that change how the game plays.
- Can play with up to 3 additional people
- A large base of information available (on steam) to research and help you understand the game better

However,

- Repetative Gameplay (without game mode changes) 
- Items are always random (unless chosing command game mode) 
- Spawn rates someone ♥♥♥♥♥♥ progression
- RNG has a huge hold over how the games go
- Item Unlock, Class Unlock and Gamemode Unlock are RNG based and can be time consuming trying to obtain
- Some unlocks are not obtainable in multiplayer mode

I personally got this game for the multi-player aspect as I enjoyed it most when I had people running around with me. However I also (recent development) focused on the achievements, and going for the specific achievements gives you a complete feel for what the game offers and what needs to be done. There are also some random ones in there, but all in all a good experience.

Highly replayable and very fun. Its hard, and you can easily die among the chaos, but it's worth it when you pull through. And even if you don't like the starting character, there are plenty more to unlock, which each play differently. You'll be sure to find one you like. There's also multiplayer, which is rather fun. Plus if you die in multiplayer, you will be brought back to life if your friends clear the level. The only problem I have with the multiplayer is that there can be an imbalance in items with multiple players. However, there are workarounds for that. All in all, I highly reccomend this game!
